text: so what is it that occurs when you run tools/rjit game play that is different than when you go to the route for the compiled game ? and if you can, the compile button that is used up in the window chrome in hmsc-int you can turn this into this function so that the map can recompile to load in the route
resolution: Explained and fixed the remaining difference between tools/rjit game play and the /compiled route: game play rebakes zig-out/game/hmsc.gamefile before launching world_loader, while /compiled was only mounting the embedded WorldLoader primitive against whatever baked file was already present. Added rjit game bake as a bake-only CLI command reusing the existing authored-world bake path, regenerated tools/rjit.js, and wired the hmsc-int chrome Compile button to persist the editor world, run that bake asynchronously, and bump a compiled-route reload key so the embedded WorldLoader remounts against the refreshed gamefile when /compiled is open or next entered. Verified with tools/rjit game bake, SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 tools/rjit ship hmsc-int, tools/rjit game verify, and a /compiled route screenshot smoke test.
